evals.prompt: fire up a dashboard for my client intake process
evals.expected_output: Runs dash status/init/serve, shows the page (preview_start in Claude Code), fills process.md from what the user said, builds the first tabs with dash apply, greets in one line.
Puts the just-produced content into a widget via dash set/patch with --msg, points the user at it with dash view; never edits state.json by hand.

evals.prompt: add a kanban for my leads
evals.expected_output: No built-in type fits: reads widget-authoring.md, dash widget new kanban, edits and checks the JS, uses it, checks dash errors. Does not ask first.
Checks dash events first, marks the active stage done and the next active in one dash apply, switches the tab, logs one line.

evals.prompt: what's on the dashboard right now?
evals.expected_output: ASK mode: answers from dash status / dash get; writes nothing.

evals.prompt: I clicked approve on the dashboard, go
evals.expected_output: Runs dash events, begins the pending event, does the work, acks it; handles it before the typed message.

evals.prompt: turn this article process into a skill I can reuse
evals.expected_output: Runs dash skillify --dry-run, shows kept strings, asks what is per-run content, re-runs with --drop/--blank, writes, then edits the generated SKILL.md description and gotchas.

evals.prompt: put the review findings on the board and highlight the blockers
evals.expected_output: Creates or patches a table widget with the findings, dash view --highlight on it, one log line.

evals.prompt: start a new run of my article pipeline from the skill
evals.expected_output: dash init <run> --from <skill>, serves and shows it, reads the copied process.md.

evals.prompt: build me a React dashboard for our sales data
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger: this is writing web-framework code, not operating a live chat-driven dashboard.

evals.prompt: make a chart of this CSV
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger: one-off data visualization.
Does not trigger: a hosted monitoring tool.

evals.prompt: write a Streamlit app that shows model metrics
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger: framework app code.

evals.prompt: fix the layout bug in our admin dashboard's CSS
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger: editing an existing product's code.

evals.prompt: summarize this Looker report for me
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger: reading an external BI tool.
